name: grill-with-ui
description: Grilling design interview rendered on a local browser page: staged answers, discussion threads, a Finish-time decision pipeline (GLOSSARY.md glossary + ADRs) with a spec readiness verdict, and the grill-monitor extension that wakes the agent once per Send instead of polling. Install with `copilot plugin install arisng/grill-with-ui`; a plugin cannot install SDK extensions, so install the bundled grill-monitor from a clone with `task ext-install`.
